works.title_ja: Fate/Grand Order
works.roles_ja: 編曲・ギター／シンセアレンジ
works.did_en: arranged “The Golden Path”, the theme song of the Fate/Grand Order Heian-kyō chapter (2020), and handled the guitar and synth arrangement and recording for the chapter; the track is included on Fate/Grand Order Original Soundtrack V (2021). In 2025 he provided arrangement support on “Iron Rose”. He is not the main composer of the game.

works.summary_en: Arranger of “The Golden Path” (Heian-kyō chapter theme, on Original Soundtrack V) and arrangement support on “Iron Rose” (2025).

works.title_ja: SK∞ エスケーエイト

The song is Langa’s theme and is included on the original soundtrack; the series score itself is by Ryo Takahashi.
